title: MGNREGA - Job Guarantee for Unskilled Work
source: Ministry of Rural Development, NREGA Official Portal

chunks.title: What is MGNREGA?
chunks.content: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) guarantees 100 days paid work yearly to rural households. Launched 2006, benefited 150+ million people. Provides: Daily wage (₹220-330 depending on state as of 2026), guaranteed work, skill development. Work includes: Road construction, water harvesting, soil conservation, embankment building, afforestation. Works in rural areas only. Universal entitlement - all landless/small farmers eligible.

chunks.title: Eligibility & Registration
chunks.content: Eligibility: Rural resident, age 18+, willing to do unskilled labor, Indian citizen. Apply at: Gram Panchayat (village council) office OR online portal nrega.nic.in. Required: Name, address, Aadhaar/bank account details. Registration is FREE. Get job card (physical) showing all work history. Once registered, demand work anytime by giving written/verbal application - have up to 15 days to provide work else payment.

chunks.title: Work & Wage Payment
chunks.content: Work provided: Construction, maintenance of public assets (roads, canals, ponds). Work hours: 8 hours daily (or 6 hours if age >60 or woman with child <6 years). Daily wage: ₹220-330 (varies by state, adjusted yearly for inflation). Wage paid within15 days of work completion. Payment method: Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) to worker's account OR check. Minimum 100 days work per household per year guaranteed - if less work provided, get unemployment allowance.

chunks.title: Safety & Entitlements
chunks.content: Workplace safety: (1) Free safety equipment provided (helmet, gloves, apron), (2) Medical facility at work site, (3) Rest shade with water + first aid. Entitlements: (1) Safety gear free, (2) Skill training during work, (3) Social security benefits (accident insurance) - if worker injured on job, government covers hospital costs + gives compensation, (4) Child care support if woman working. Complaint/grievance: Contact Gram Panchayat OR call NREGA helpline.

chunks.title: Check Status and Get Help
chunks.content: Check work history/wage status: (1) In-person at Gram Panchayat, (2) Online: nrega.nic.in - enter job card number + state, (3) Phone: AAYOG helpline (varies by state). If wage delayed: File complaint at Gram Panchayat OR online portal - get 0.05% compensation per day for delay. If work refused: Escalate to Block Development Officer (BDO). If accident on job: Report immediately, get medical aid + file claim. Minimum 100 days guaranteed - if not provided, eligible for unemployment allowance (₹200/day for shortfall days).
